---
title: "Recall analyses"
---

Dataset calculations pool counts or measurements across selected trials.
Participant-summary functions keep one row per participant; plotters average
those rows with equal weight. Numerical functions support JAX where their
docstrings specify it. Plotting and statistical comparisons run outside JIT.

Recall codes identify one-based study positions. For item recall probabilities,
one response credits every presentation of that item, once per trial. Serial
accuracy and output-position measures retain their own response-order rules.
Each entry describes the observations and denominator used by its calculation.

## Recall and output position

- [`spc`](analyses-spc.qmd): Serial position curve analyses.
- [`pnr`](analyses-pnr.qmd): Probability of nth recall (PNR).
- [`nth_item_recall`](analyses-nth_item_recall.qmd): Nth-item recall curves.
- [`termination_probability`](analyses-termination_probability.qmd): Termination probability curves.

## Serial recall accuracy

- [`srac`](analyses-srac.qmd): Serial Recall Accuracy Curve (SRAC).
- [`relative_srac`](analyses-relative_srac.qmd): Relative Serial Recall Accuracy Curve.
- [`repsrac`](analyses-repsrac.qmd): Repetition-index serial recall accuracy.
- [`intrusion_error_rate`](analyses-intrusion_error_rate.qmd): Intrusions at expected serial-recall response positions.
- [`omission_error_rate`](analyses-omission_error_rate.qmd): Omission error rate analysis.
- [`order_error_rate`](analyses-order_error_rate.qmd): Order error rate analysis.

## Categories and study measurements

- [`cat_recall_rate`](analyses-cat_recall_rate.qmd): Category-filtered recall-rate analyses.
- [`cat_spc`](analyses-cat_spc.qmd): Category-filtered serial position curve analyses.
- [`factors`](analyses-factors.qmd): Measurements associated with study items, and recall probability by measurement.

## Co-recall

- [`corecall`](analyses-corecall.qmd): Joint and conditional recall of pairs of different study items.

## Transitions and organization

- [`crp`](analyses-crp.qmd): Lag-Conditional Response Probability (Lag-CRP).
- [`conditional_crp`](analyses-conditional_crp.qmd): Lag-CRP with conditional transition filtering.
- [`distcrp`](analyses-distcrp.qmd): Distance-binned conditional response probabilities.
- [`conditional_distcrp`](analyses-conditional_distcrp.qmd): Distance-binned CRP with conditional transition filtering.
- [`lagrank`](analyses-lagrank.qmd): Lag-Rank Temporal Factor Score.
- [`distrank`](analyses-distrank.qmd): Distance-Rank Semantic Factor Score.
- [`cue_centered_crp`](analyses-cue_centered_crp.qmd): Cue-centered Lag-CRP.
- [`source_target_crp`](analyses-source_target_crp.qmd): Source-target conditional response probability.

## Repeated items

- [`repcrp`](analyses-repcrp.qmd): Repetition conditional response probability.
- [`repaccesscrp`](analyses-repaccesscrp.qmd): Forward repetition access lag-CRP.
- [`repneighborcrp`](analyses-repneighborcrp.qmd): Repetition-neighbor lag-conditional response probability.
- [`reproutecrp`](analyses-reproutecrp.qmd): Route-conditioned repetition lag-conditional response probability.
- [`repcuecrp`](analyses-repcuecrp.qmd): Prior-conditioned repetition cue lag-CRP.
- [`serialrepcrp`](analyses-serialrepcrp.qmd): Serial repetition CRP conditioned on correct run-up.
- [`rpl`](analyses-rpl.qmd): Recall probability as a function of repeated-item spacing.

## Participant summaries and comparisons

- [`statistics`](analyses-statistics.qmd): Summarize participant scores and compare paired measurements.

[Experimental analyses](experimental.qmd) are documented separately; their scientific interfaces remain provisional.
